links.comparator_used: Baseline model predictions without FairICP, plus four benchmark frameworks (unfairness mitigation methods)
links.outcome: Prediction accuracy and accuracy gap between privileged and unprivileged subpopulations across cardiac MRI, chest X-ray and dermatology imaging
links.effect: Accuracy improved by 7.2% and the accuracy gap between privileged and unprivileged subpopulations was reduced by 2.2% on average across all three datasets, compared with baseline
links.quote: Compared to the baseline, FairICP improved prediction accuracy by 7.2% and reduced the accuracy gap between the privileged and unprivileged subpopulations by 2.2% on average across all three datasets.

design_hint: post-implementation group-specific conformal prediction filtering of uncertain predictions
